The site named above has been audited by NSF International Certification Services against the certification scheme shown and found to be in conformance. The scope of certification covers the manufacture of dried dairy ingredients, including receipt, evaporation, spray drying, packaging and warehousing.

This certificate remains valid until the expiry date shown, subject to satisfactory surveillance and to the site continuing to meet the requirements of the scheme. The SQF Program is owned and administered by SQFI, a division of FMI; accreditation of this certification body is held with ANAB.
